assumptions: ROUGH ESTIMATE ONLY. Encode speed depends on device, encoder (H.264 vs HEVC vs AV1), resolution, and effect complexity.
Tier defaults below are TUNABLE starting points, not measured benchmarks; UI must show assumptions and a range.
AV1 encodes much slower than H.264 — apply codecMultiplier (H.264=1.0, HEVC≈1.6, AV1≈4.0 as rough defaults).
formulas.formula: renderSec_low/high = durationSec * fps * secPerFrame1080p * resolutionFactor * effectMultiplier * codecMultiplier, with secPerFrame range per deviceTier
formulas.name: Render/export time estimate

testCases.note: hand-computed from tier defaults: 1800 frames x 0.03-0.12 s/frame x 1.5 effect = 81-324 s

assumptions: Formula is the WCAG 2.1 definition; thresholds are WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3 (AA) / 1.4.6 (AAA).
Transparent backgrounds ('none') cannot produce a guaranteed ratio — tool must compute against a user-declared backdrop or warn.
formulas.formula: contrast = (L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05), where L = relative luminance: for each sRGB channel c: c_lin = c/12.92 if c<=0.04045 else ((c+0.055)/1.055)^2.4; L = 0.2126*R_lin + 0.7152*G_lin + 0.0722*B_lin
formulas.name: WCAG contrast ratio

testCases.note: #777 on white = 4.48:1, just under 4.5:1 AA -> fail (hand-computed)

formulas.formula: for target W:H from source w×h: if source wider than target -> cropW = h*(W/H), x centered (or anchor); else cropH = w*(H/W)

assumptions: SRT is a de-facto format (no formal spec); rules below follow the SubRip convention confirmed by subtitle tooling docs.
WebVTT is the W3C standard: https://www.w3.org/TR/webvtt1/ — file must start with 'WEBVTT', timestamps use '.' decimals.
formulas.formula: SRT block = sequenceNumber CRLF HH:MM:SS,mmm --> HH:MM:SS,mmm CRLF textLines; blocks separated by blank line. Validation: numbering sequential, timestamps well-formed, end>start, start >= prev end (warn on overlap)
formulas.name: SRT structure and validation rules

note: status 'guidance' = sound math/practice heuristic that is not a published standard; UI must label it as guidance, not a standard.
